basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 24-year-old fashion enthusiast living in Vancouver, Canada. I recently got into the world of high-performance athletic wear and fell in love with Lululemon's unique designs and quality. I work as a part-time yoga instructor and spend my free time exploring the beautiful outdoors of British Columbia. I'm also an avid motorcycle rider, recently having joined the community of FZ07 enthusiasts. When I'm not teaching or riding, I'm usually scrolling through Reddit to find new fashion trends and restock alerts. I'm currently single and typically online in the evenings after my yoga classes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a diploma in fashion merchandising and have been self-teaching about high-performance fabrics and design through online courses and community discussions. My interest in motorcycles comes from my family, as my dad used to take me on rides growing up.
